payload.title: Run strict V9 locally, then physical BASE14 acceptance
payload.work_clay: LATEST REVISION WINS. GitHub-hosted Actions is currently a negative infrastructure route: PR37 ClayCode BASE Frontend CI and the independent Identity Guard both failed before Step 1; the ClayCode rerun reproduced zero executed steps. Read research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/CI_STRICT_V9_GITHUB_ACTIONS_INFRA_NEGATIVE_20260809.json and do not interpret those failures as parser evidence. On the verified Ubuntu/local executor with lark+interegular installed, pull newest main and first run: python3 tools/claycode_base_frontend_validation.py --grammar research_entity/claycode/base/D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V9.lark --output research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_FRONTEND_V9_STRICT.json ; python3 tools/claycode_base_canonicalizer.py --grammar research_entity/claycode/base/D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V9.lark --output research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_CANONICAL_V9_STRICT.json ; python3 tools/claycode_base_ir.py research_entity/claycode/g9/CLAYCODE_G9_FUSION_SPEC_V3.clay --grammar research_entity/claycode/base/D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V9.lark --output research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_IR_G9_V3_V9_STRICT.json ; python3 tools/claycode_base_ir.py research_entity/claycode/g9/DIALECT_REGISTRY_V3.clay --grammar research_entity/claycode/base/D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V9.lark --output research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_IR_DIALECT_V3_V9_STRICT.json ; python3 tools/claycode_base_ir.py --self-test --grammar research_entity/claycode/base/D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V9.lark --output research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_IR_SELFTEST_V9_STRICT.json. Persist exact environment/package versions, git HEAD, V9 grammar hash and receipt hashes. If and only if all strict V9 receipts pass, optionally run tools/claycode_v10_unified_frontend_discriminator.py under strict dependencies as a non-promoting research discriminator. Then on the registered physical Andreas Ubuntu target run bash tools/claycode_bootstrap_andreas_self_hosted_runner.sh and python3 tools/claycode_run_andreas_target_acceptance.py. Never widen BASE for frank_runtime.clay: that file is CONTEXT_ONLY_NON_GATE unless explicitly selected as a production executable. Preserve negative receipts; never weaken target, desktop, clean-tree, authority, APP01-10, FULL_FRANK or WP14 gates.
payload.reason_clay: The hosted CI transport was directly observed twice and failed before any workflow step; the independent Identity Guard showed the same signature, so no ClayCode semantic inference is warranted. The remaining executable path is a strict local Ubuntu V9 receipt followed by the already prepared physical Andreas BASE14/FULL_FRANK chain.
payload.completion_clay: Strict stage completes only with all five local V9 receipts PASS and grammar/package/git identities recorded. Overall work completes only after physical Andreas scoped-runner/autoprobe, BASE14 closure, strict target acceptance, ten application receipts, five-path FULL_FRANK receipt and independent WP14 PASS are present on main and the manifest promotes without open P0/P1 defects.
